slots.purpose: Hero: show that a reception without a seating chart still feels considered and luxurious, with guests moving and mixing freely.
slots.shot_brief: Real, licensed photo of a relaxed luxury reception: either a long candlelit communal table or a lounge setting with low sofas and side tables, guests standing, leaning in and mixing across groups, couple visible but not posed. Warm dusk or candlelight, garden, terrace or villa courtyard, late spring to summer. No place cards with legible names, no seating chart signage, no logos. Consenting couple and identifiable guests. Never AI.
